content.short: Houdini offers non-custodial cross-chain swaps across 100+ chains with privacy features.
content.description: Houdini performs non-custodial swaps across more than a hundred chains with a privacy layer between the sending and receiving addresses, positioning itself as compliant privacy rather than a mixer. Monad's documentation lists it under cross-chain tooling. Privacy tooling in this space carries obvious regulatory weight, and the products that survive tend to be the ones that engage with screening rather than avoid it.
